headline: Record quarter as data center and industrial lift margins
summary_short: Analog Devices' quarter ended Oct. 31, 2026 had revenue of $4.37B, up 42% y/y, with adjusted EPS of $4.06 versus $2.26 a year ago. Q1 FY27 revenue is guided to $4.4B, plus or minus $150M.
summary_long: Revenue rose 42% y/y to $4,373M; gross margin expanded 620bp to 69.3% and operating margin 1,200bp to 42.7%. Growth was led by Data Center and Industrial. Operating cash flow was $2,341M and free cash flow $2,001M after $340M capex. The company returned $1,410M via dividends and buybacks. Q1 FY27 outlook: revenue $4.4B +/- $150M, adjusted EPS $3.82 +/- $0.20; quarterly dividend of $1.10 declared.
confidence_notes: Period label mismatch: the shard labels this event FY2026 Q3, but the EX-99.1 is ADI's fiscal Q4 and full-year FY2026 release (quarter ended Oct. 31, 2026); all figures here come from the release. Free cash flow y/y (+35%) is derived from the release's $2,001M versus $1,486M implied by prior-year operating cash flow $1,701M less capex $215M. q/q deltas are not given and are omitted.

drivers.explanation: Year-over-year growth was led by Data Center and Industrial. The CEO says AI infrastructure drives data center and ATE strength, while over two-thirds of fiscal 2026 growth came from non-AI-centric markets.
Not explained in the release beyond the reported 620bp expansion on much higher revenue.
Operating cash flow of $2,341M exceeded capex of $340M by a wide margin, with free cash flow at 46% of revenue.
